facts.text: Deborah received a quote from a friend who is no longer able to support her, and the quote is 'Let go of what no longer serves you.'

evidence.quote: This was written to me by a friend who, unfortunately, will never be able to support me. I miss him here. This quote says 'Let go of what no longer serves you.'

facts.text: Jolene references a quote in her notebook that inspires her and reminds her to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves them.

evidence.quote: I'm sorry! That's a good reminder to stay focused and let go of what no longer serves us. Remember the quote in my notebook? It also inspires me!

facts.text: Jolene shares a quote she found while browsing that encourages focusing on growth and positivity while ditching negative stuff.

evidence.quote: I came across this one while browsing and it really hit home with me. It's a great reminder to ditch the negative stuff and focus on growing and being positive.

facts.text: Deborah agrees with Jolene's perspective on surrounding themselves with good stuff and striving to improve.

evidence.quote: Surrounding ourselves with good stuff and striving to improve is key.
